How it works

From application to live giveaway

A guided process designed for creators who want professionalism without complexity.

Apply

Submit your creator profile, audience details and sweepstakes idea. Our team reviews every application.

Build

Use the creator dashboard to set your prize, ticket price, dates and campaign details. Preview before submitting.

Get verified

Gaviom verifies your identity, prize authenticity and compliance. Once approved, your giveaway goes live.

Launch & earn

Share your branded giveaway page. Your community buys entries. Gaviom runs the draw and handles winner verification.

FAQ

Common questions

We review your identity, social profiles, audience authenticity and sweepstakes proposal. Every creator is manually approved before accessing the dashboard. Verified creators receive a Gaviom badge visible on all their giveaway pages.

Creators provide and fund their own prizes. You upload proof of ownership or purchase during campaign setup. Gaviom verifies the prize before approval. After the draw, delivery is confirmed and documented.

Gaviom uses cryptographically secure random selection from the verified entry pool. The process is auditable, transparent, and announced publicly. Winners are verified for eligibility before prize delivery.

Revenue from ticket sales is tracked in your creator dashboard. After the draw completes and the winner is verified, your share (minus the Gaviom platform fee) is paid out via Stripe Connect within 5–7 business days.

Starter creators: 3–5 business days. Pro creators: 1–2 business days. Partner creators: dedicated onboarding timeline. You'll receive email updates at each review stage.

Yes. Brands, public figures and companies can apply as Partner Creators. We also offer enterprise programs through Gaviom for Business for larger-scale campaigns.

Gaviom maintains escrow and dispute policies. If a prize cannot be delivered, the creator is responsible for providing an equivalent substitute or cash alternative. Gaviom mediates and may issue refunds per official rules.
